source: Worked example — the shape a local organization fills in to add a jurisdiction. All records are fictional.

items.title: Registering a land title at the district office
items.explanation: A land title is registered at the district office covering the plot, not the applicant's home district. The office publishes a searchable index of pending registrations, and an objection must be filed while a registration is still pending — once it completes, the only route is the courts.
items.verificationMethod: Checked against the published fee schedule and the counter hours posted at the district office.
items.eligibility: The registered owner, or a representative holding written authority.
requirements: Site plan prepared by a licensed surveyor
Proof of the current owner's identity
Evidence of how the plot was acquired
items.fees: Scaled by plot value; the published schedule starts at GHS 250.
items.deadlines: An objection must be filed while the registration is still pending.
whatRemainsUncertain: Whether the published fee schedule has been revised for the current year — the office confirmed the range verbally but has not reissued it.

fr.title: Enregistrer un titre foncier au bureau de district
fr.explanation: Un titre foncier s'enregistre au bureau de district dont relève la parcelle, et non celui du domicile du demandeur. Le bureau publie un index consultable des enregistrements en cours ; une opposition doit être déposée tant que l'enregistrement est en cours — une fois abouti, seul le tribunal reste ouvert.
fr.eligibility: Le propriétaire enregistré, ou un représentant muni d'une autorisation écrite.

items.title: What a community may ask for during a prolonged water outage
items.explanation: Where a supply interruption is expected to last more than 72 hours, the utility publishes an alternative supply plan for the affected area. The plan names the delivery points; it does not commit to a volume per household.
items.verificationMethod: Last confirmed against the published service standard. Two regional notices issued since have not been reconciled with it.
whatRemainsUncertain: Whether the regional notices change the 72-hour threshold.
Which delivery points are currently active — no live list is published.
